golden_baseline_location: recomputed live from Oracle by the recon harness at grade time (.migration/recon/customers/result.json); no baseline is derived from migration output

acceptance_checks.description: Every mapped collection's document count equals its Oracle row count through the mapping (zero tolerance, tolerances v1).
Per-field aggregates and a keyed diff agree after the Oracle canonicalization rules; NUMBER never lands as double.
Re-running the load leaves document counts and content identical (natural _id + upsert), and recon still passes.
The unit ships only on a PASS in the harness result.json; no loader self-report substitutes for it.
Every embedded array is graded on parent key, element key and mapped fields; an UNGRADED embed blocks the unit.
CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST is empty at source and must still produce an explicit empty collection with PASS evidence.

planted_anomalies.description: 50 CUSTOMER_MASTER.SIGNUP_DT values are not parseable DD-MON-YY; each is quarantined with its raw string preserved, never coerced to a plausible date
31 RELATED_ACCT_IDS CSV values are malformed; quarantined with the raw value, the rest become arrays
187 (entity_id, attr_name) pairs repeat, up to 3 rows each; attributes is an array so no duplicate is silently collapsed

encoding_policy.input_encoding: Oracle AL32UTF8, read as Python str via python-oracledb
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: strings are preserved byte-exact; no case folding, no Unicode normalization, no transliteration. CHAR columns are right-trimmed (the padding is Oracle's storage artifact, not data) and Oracle's empty string is NULL, so the target field is omitted.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: none observed in the census; an undecodable value would fail the load loudly rather than being replaced with U+FFFD, since a substitution would silently pass a byte-exact comparison it should fail.

malformed_record_policy.details: Malformed values are quarantined with the raw source value and its key, never coerced or dropped; quarantine counts are graded against the census. NULL and a missing target field are equivalent for comparison, so an omitted field is not read as data loss.

empty_input_semantics.details: CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST is empty at source; the collection is created empty so a downstream count check sees a real zero rather than an absent collection.
